title: UI: v2, the big clean up
body: While the npub.cash website was meant to be a demo app for the npubcash-server API, it evolved to something bigger over time. Because this service is supposed to be focused on the service itself, this PR aims to restore the more minimalistic nature of npub.cash's frontend.

title: Replace hardcoded server URL with env var
added qr codes to cashu claim
body:
Added @gandlafbtc 's UR lib https://github.com/gandlafbtc/bc-ur to add animated MUR codes to npub.cash

Took this opportunity to slightly refactor the claim modal too.
